<thought>To retrieve the template that generates the Still‑Gennari precursors, I will search the template catalog using the product SMILES and the functional groups that are formed in the forward reaction (a C‑C double bond and a carboxylic ester). This should return the template_id and mapped_rxn needed to construct the retrosynthesis route.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](CC=O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds", "carboxylic esters"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
